Author: JustPixelll
Name: Should I?
Punchline: Know what to sell, buy, craft, gather — and what to do next.
Description: FFXIV economy decision support for Dalamud. Ranks selling, buying, crafting and gathering opportunities using Universalis, inventory/Market Board observations, vendor economics and your own trading history. Includes native item-tooltip insights, inventory right-click lookups, unified Opportunities, cashflow/FIFO analytics and personal sales/listing history. No automated buying, selling, repricing or queued native Market Board scanning.
Changelog: v2.3.0 preparation: native FFXIV item-tooltip integration, first-run setup, refreshed launcher/repository presentation, and official-submission readiness work.
